results.title: Solis
results.overview: After a string of devastating setbacks—including the loss of his father, a broken relationship, and endless rejection in the search for work—a young man finds himself at his lowest point. Just when hope seems out of reach, he discovers an unexpected escape through music. As melodies become his lifeline, he must decide whether he can turn his pain into purpose before life slips away completely.

results.title: Hellbilly Hollow
results.overview: A team of paranormal YouTubers venture deep into the Alabama backwoods to film at a haunted attraction the day before Halloween. They encounter a sinister presence far more frightening - and deadlier - than specters and staged scares: Tickles and his caretaker brother Bull. One by one, the investigators, together with local thrill-seekers, fall victim!

results.title: Normal
results.overview: Normal is an anthology film comprising three socially relevant stories set during the COVID-19 lockdown period. The film explores how certain social conditions remained unchanged despite the pandemic.

results.title: The Bench
results.overview: All Risto wants is a peaceful burial for his mother - but family is family.

results.title: Partners
results.overview: Engaged couple Faye and Peter reunite with old friends one hot Southern night; however, when secrets are uncovered, the status quo of their "straight" relationship is thrown into question.

results.title: UFC 326: Holloway vs. Oliveira 2
results.overview: UFC 326: Holloway vs. Oliveira 2 was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on March 7, 2026, at the T-Mobile Arena in Paradise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Valley, United States.

results.title: The Hoodoos
results.overview: When a crew of criminals attempts to steal cursed Confederate gold from a haunted Louisiana plantation, they discover that the voodoo protecting the treasure is terrifyingly real… and the dolls are awake.

results.title: Nimesh Patel: Buy The Dip
results.overview: In his first Netflix special, Nimesh Patel talks rebelling against his traditional parents and why you should never go viral in India.

results.title: Seres
results.overview: When a strange object crosses the sky and triggers a global alert, two young couples find themselves trapped in a series of increasingly disturbing events. What begins as a getaway out of town transforms into a struggle for survival as they discover they are being hunted by unknown forces.

results.title: The Male Gaze: Courage Under Fire
results.original_title: The Male Gaze: Courage Under Fire
results.overview: Whether it's finding the strength to speak truth to power, making a decision that will mark you as an outsider, or taking a risk that will expose a secret - these men and boys prove that sometimes courage is not learned. It is an instinct.

results.title: Eden's Choice
results.overview: In a time when the abortion debate continues to divide culture, politics, and communities across America, this deeply emotional film cuts through the noise to tell a raw and unforgettable human story, one that challenges audiences to see the person behind the issue. EDEN’S CHOICE follows the journey of 13 year old Eden, a young girl facing abuse, poverty, and an unplanned pregnancy. As her family crumbles and her circumstances spiral beyond her control, Eden is forced to make a decision that will shape the rest of her life. Choosing courage over fear, she makes the life altering decision to choose life. What follows is a powerful journey of sacrifice, perseverance, and ultimately, redemption, as Eden comes to understand the profound impact of her choice years later.

results.title: The Girl with the Leica
results.overview: On Bastille Day in 1937, pioneering German-Jewish photojournalist Gerda Taro spends her final day in Paris confronting her past, her complex partnership with Robert Capa, and her absolute commitment to anti-fascist resistance before returning to the front lines of the Spanish Civil War.

results.title: Penunggu Rumah: Buto Ijo
results.overview: Srini, a single mother, faces disturbances from a giant figure as her child's 6th birthday nears. Seeking help, she contacts her ex, Ali, a horror content creator. Ali and his sister, Lana, agree to assist due to financial struggles. However, as the figure of Buto Ijo appears, terror unfolds, revealing dark secrets in Srini's home.

results.title: AURORA: What Happened to the Earth? Live From Mexico City
results.original_title: AURORA: What Happened to the Earth? Live From Mexico City
results.overview: Norwegian alt-pop artist AURORA plays her biggest ever headline performance at Mexico City’s Palacio de los Deportes as part of her What Happened to the Earth? Tour. Filmed live on Dia De Los Muertos (Day of the Dead), the arena is transformed into a space of spellbinding sound and light, and filled with fans in festive dress. AURORA’s ethereal voice is ever-captivating as she sings haunting ballads including 'Dreams' and 'Exist for Love' as well as fan-favourites 'Runaway', 'The Seed' and 'Churchyard'. Known for blending electronic pop with folk and vivid storytelling, AURORA’s performances are always immersive and emotional, and this concert – celebrating nature and the human experience – solidifies her as a beacon of originality and inspiration.

results.title: Wolves
results.overview: Luana feels trapped; she is frustrated with society, her family, and her job at a crèche. She searches for stability and a sense of belonging, and finds both in the local black metal scene. While accompanying her cousin's band on tour as their social media manager, she falls in love with the charismatic singer, Wiktor. When his more radical views come to light, causing tension within the band, Luana refuses to see the truth and cannot let him go.

results.title: Remember Julia
results.original_title: Μια Μικρή Ιστορία Αντίστασης. Ιουλία Μπίμπα
results.overview: Fragments from the life of Julia Biba, a heroic resistance fighter active in occupied Athens, who fought until the very end against the brutal violence of Nazism.
